headline: Medford High School project: press release on costs and next steps approved
summary: A joint meeting with the School Committee is set for November 30th, and a February 2nd, 2027 meeting will share the cost impact. Public speakers put the total cost near $700 million and asked the city to lower it. Other approvals included a National Grid gas main on Fulton Street and Brogan Road and a zoning change for vacant properties. A resolution also asks the administration for a report on the possible sale of Cataldo Ambulance.
decisions: Approved a resolution inviting residents to Mama's free store and the winter preparedness event.
Approved the Public Works and Facilities Committee report from October 21st, 2026.
Approved National Grid's grant of location for 1,665 feet of gas main on Fulton Street and Brogan Road, six in favor, none opposed, one absent.
Approved deleting zoning section 94-7.5 on vacant and foreclosing properties, effective August 4th, 2027, the same date as the new vacant building ordinance.
Approved a resolution asking the administration for an update on the vacancy in the Veterans Department.
Approved the joint press release on the Medford High School project, six in favor and one absent.
Approved a resolution asking the administration for an update and analysis on the possible sale of Cataldo Ambulance.
Approved $35,000 from the general stabilization fund for the police chief search consultant, MGT.
Approved $85,000 for recreation center schematic drawings and a feasibility study, $71,000 for fire headquarters repairs, and $24,476.44 for old police station flooding repairs.
Tabled a supplemental appropriation of $269,295 and 81 cents for the law department budget until the next regular meeting.
Referred the Fire Department unmanned aerial system use policy to the Public Health and Community Safety Committee.
discussion: High school cost concerns: Public speakers said the project costs about $700 million and that taxpayers would finance about $500 million. They asked for a smaller project and a clearer basis for the figures.

High school financing plan: Members discussed adding financial experts to the task force and ways to lower taxpayer costs, such as new growth and city pension funds. A firm cost figure is expected at the February 2nd, 2027 meeting.

Law Department funding: The administration said the money could not be levied after the November 17th tax classification hearing. Members discussed other options, including a contingency account, and asked for answers to earlier requests.
Police chief search format: Members asked for a public meeting with the recruiting firm, MGT. The chief of staff said the firm advised smaller sessions because recruitment details are not public.

Sturgis Street traffic: Residents asked for a speed table or speed bumps and a stop sign at Sturgis and Morgan. Councillors said they will set up a Saturday site meeting with the traffic engineer and police.
